title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: slab position of billed detention days
content:
## Scope

Within the AHL Demurrage and Detention Free Time category, this rule decides which charge slab each billed detention day of a per-container record falls in.

## Rule

1. **Separate clock model.** The slab count of the detention days starts at the first detention day.
2. **Combined clock model, import record.** The slab count of the detention days continues after the chargeable demurrage days that precede them in the merged clock.
3. **Combined clock model, export record.** The slab count starts at the first chargeable day.
4. A day's slab is 1 while its position in the slab count is at most the slab 1 length, 2 while it is at most the slab 1 length plus the slab 2 length, 3 while it is at most the total of the three slab lengths, and 4 afterwards.

## Counting in words

- On a combined import record, the chargeable demurrage days that precede the detention days are the smaller of the days used and the position of the full gate-out date in the merged clock, less the merged free days, and none when that figure does not exceed the free days. The detention days then take the slab positions that follow.
- In every other case the detention days take slab positions from 1 upward.
- The days in each slab are the billed detention days whose slab position falls within that slab's range.

## Worked example (hypothetical slab lengths of 4, 4 and 8 days, used only to show the counting)

A combined import record has 6 chargeable demurrage days before gate-out and 7 billed detention days. The detention days take slab positions 7 to 13: positions 7 and 8 are slab 2 days, and positions 9 to 13 are slab 3 days. No detention day is in slab 1.

| Reading | Slab 1 | Slab 2 | Slab 3 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Correct: count continues after the 6 preceding demurrage days | 0 | 2 | 5 |
| Wrong: count restarted at the first detention day | 4 | 3 | 0 |

On a combined export record with 7 billed detention days, the same hypothetical lengths give 4 days in slab 1 and 3 in slab 2, because the count starts at the first chargeable day.
